svg.text: 180° ROTATIONAL AMBIGRAM — STUDY SHEET / GEOMETRIC SANS
authored as one half + its own rotation · the right half of this word does not exist as artwork
monotone, as it would actually be used
identical to the row above, pixel for pixel — that is what makes it an ambigram
black = primary letterform · grey = secondary · red = rule motif
top row: what the position reads upright · bottom row: what the SAME artwork reads rotated
an ambigram that only works at full width is not finished
pivot O + rule motif, cropped square — self-rotational, so it is its own ambigram
• M / T — structurally unsolvable at 1:1. Full-height edge stems rotate to full-height edge stems, and the T has none. Carried by context + the rule motif.
• R / P — same handedness, same wall. The right-hand rule gives the P a stem; the bowl still lands in the wrong half. Carried by context.
• O / N — N is intrinsically 180°-symmetric, so this pair really does want one picture. Long straight sides + light curves push it off Ø and toward N.
• P / O — rotates to a lowercase o with a post on its right. Tighten gap 4-5 further to ligature that post into p10's stem.
